description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'Node' for creating views with a wizard interface, including methods for configuring display options, filters, and sorting for node entities.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for creating and configuring node views using a wizard interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Node plugin with dependencies for display and field management.

methods.name: getAvailableSorts
methods.description: Returns available sorting options for the node view, specifically by title in ascending order.

methods.name: rowStyleOptions
methods.description: Provides options for different row styles in the view, such as teasers, full posts, and titles.

methods.name: defaultDisplayOptions
methods.description: Sets default display options, including access permissions and adding a title field.

methods.name: defaultDisplayFiltersUser
methods.description: Builds user-specific filters, particularly for tagged taxonomy terms.

methods.name: pageDisplayOptions
methods.description: Configures display options for page views, including row plugin settings.

methods.name: blockDisplayOptions
methods.description: Configures display options for block views, including row plugin settings.

methods.name: display_options_row
methods.description: Sets row style and plugin options based on selected row plugin type.

methods.name: buildFilters
methods.description: Adds taxonomy term filtering capabilities to the view, with autocomplete for tags.
